description: Stabs deep and cuts twice.

name: Javelin
description: A ranged variation of the spear.

name: Spear (Enhanced)

specials.name: Enhanced Stats
specials.description: +3 STR

description: Your standard, boring spear.

name: Greatspear
description: A heavier spear that deals more damage. While not the trademark of a particular nation, Wyvernriders often use them in battle, as their mobility is not hindered by the weapon's weight.

name: Holy Lance

specials.name: Light Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Light bonus damage equal to 50% of your Light ATK, which ignores armor.

description: Divinity in the form of a spear.

name: Impaler

specials.name: Vampiric
specials.description: Vampiric (10%) (Basic attacks only)

description: A vampiric spear that sucks the blood of those it stabs.

name: Shizumare

specials.name: Silence
specials.description: Inflict Silence for 2 rounds. (Cannot be reapplied to that target for 4 rounds afterwards.)

description: A deadly blow from this weapon will leave an enemy speechless.

name: Warstaff
description: A heavier, more powerful version of your average quarterstaff, the war staff is often used as a momentum-based weapon.

name: Siphon

specials.name: Focus Restoration
specials.description: Restores Focus based on damage dealt. (10%) (Basic attacks only)

specials.name: Wind Voltic
specials.description: Launches a magically charged slash through all enemies in a 5 Range line that deals Wind magic damage equal to Siphon's SWA + 100% of your Wind ATK. You also drain 10% of the damage dealt from all enemies hit as FP.

description: This spear draws out and absorbs Focus from enemy wounds.

name: Soulstealer

specials.name: WIL Absorption
specials.description: Absorbs part of the target's spiritual power, increasing your WIL by 15% of their WIL for 3 turns.

description: An essence stealing demonic spear.

name: Voidcut

specials.name: WIL Reduction
specials.description: Torments the target with horrible visions, lowering their WIL by 20% for 3 turns.

description: From another world.

name: Bamboo-Bo

specials.name: Pole Slots
specials.description: Has two pole slots.

description: A hard, wooden bo staff. It is about as long as a spear, but has no spearhead.

name: Cerron Scepter

specials.name: Water Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Water bonus damage equal to 50% of your Water ATK, which ignores armor.

specials.name: Spell Power Bonus
specials.description: +10% Power to Aquarian Spells (Halved if not main weapon.)

description: A frigid spear that explodes with a burst of freezing cold water.

name: King Fisher

specials.name: Passive
specials.description: +1 Attack Range if weapon made of Thinsteel.

specials.name: Passive
specials.description: On Hit: Apply or power up String Attached (LV 1, max 4, 3 rounds). Only 1 string can attached per action (even if you have multiple Puppet Strings equipped, or attack with it multiple times).

description: 1 Momentum, 0 FP, 5 range, 1 round CD With a feather-like texture, you'd think this whip would be soft, but being struck by it is anything but. In fact, the more it strikes, the wilder it gets, kicking up the winds around you.

name: Monk Priest's Staff

specials.name: Sanctify
specials.description: Targets a 1 Range diamond around your position and removes most special effects tiles inside of it, destroying them, and creates a Sanctuary for 3 rounds with LV X (X = 1 + Power upgrade of Monk-Priest's Staff). Requires 2 durability to use and will fail if below that.

description: A staff used by priests. When slammed into the ground, it makes a distinctive jingle.

name: Pilfer Spear

specials.name: Steal Bonus
specials.description: Increases Steal's success rate by 15%.

specials.name: Pilfer
specials.description: Targets one enemy within 1 Range. Messes with the target's inventory, preventing them from using items for 2 rounds.

description: Poke 'em and keep what sticks.

name: Tuning Fork

specials.name: Sound Damage
specials.description: Deals up to X (X = character level or 10, whichever is higher) Sound magic damage to the target. (Depends on enemy armor. Heavy Armor = 100%, Light Armor = 50%, Unarmored = 25%)

specials.name: Tile Destruction
specials.description: When played (via a Song skill): Destroys special effect tiles with 1 Hardiness created by enemies within 2 Range. (If a special effect tile is destroyed, this effect goes on a 3 round Cooldown.)

description: A dual-forked spear with a blunt head. When it is struck on something hard, it creates a loud tone.

name: Excel Hasta

specials.name: Weapon Charge Consumption
specials.description: Consumes Weapon Charges, dealing 50% more damage per Charge Level.

specials.name: Charge Weapon
specials.description: Rev your weapon and fill it with focus, increasing its Charge, to a maximum of level 3. When you hit with a weapon that can consume Weapon Charges, the damage you deal with that attack will increase by 50% per level. (Weapon Charges will expire after 5 rounds.)

specials.name: Elite Engine
specials.description: Shared Potential Skill. Charge Weapon FP cost is increased to 8 FP. Attacks do not use up all of your charges, instead the LV is reduced by 1, and the damage bonus is 35% (does not increase with charge amount like normal Excel attacks).

description: 3 Momentum, 5 FP The Excel line of weapons were developed in Chaturanga, where the ability to be defensive while increasing offensive capabilities was highly valued. By charging up the weapon, it can explosively spend the focus energy when it strikes an enemy, greatly increasing damage. However, the engine module makes it heavier than other weapons.

name: Firepoker

specials.name: Fire Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Fire bonus damage equal to 50% of your Fire ATK, which ignores armor.

specials.name: Coal Brand
specials.description: Triggers before an enemy is attacked. Inflicts the target with Elemental Pierce (Fire) (2 rounds), and if it hits, all other enemies in 5 Range of the target take Firepoker's On Hit effects.

description: Not your average fireplace tool.

name: Sasumata

specials.name: Sasumata
specials.description: Once per round (per enemy), after an enemy uses an action that moves them into the tile you are facing; if your STR is greater than their Battle Weight (ignoring reductions; monsters use their level instead), you push them back 1 tile and inflict them with Clumsy (1 round). Otherwise, you inflict them with Impaired Attack (LV 5, until your next turn, effect ends when enemy is no longer close to you).

specials.name: Subdue & Restrain
specials.description: Targets an enemy in 1 Range and applies an effect. If the target is Knocked Down, you pin them with the Sasumata, inflicting Grappled (2 rounds) and Impaired Attack (LV 10, 2 rounds). If not, if you are behind the target, you strike their knees and inflict them with Knocked Down. If none of the other effects activate, you knock them back 2 tiles and recover 2M.

description: A polearm with a dull crescent edge and a row of spikes near it. It is frequently used by guards in certain cultures as a means to restrain the aggressive, such as animals or criminals, or to keep them away.

name: Sleigher

specials.name: Ice Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Ice bonus damage equal to 50% of your Ice ATK, which ignores armor.

description: Used by a demon from the north to trim people from his list of evil-doers.

name: Abberation Spear

specials.name: Lightning Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Lightning bonus damage equal to 50% of your Lightning ATK, which ignores armor.

specials.name: Spell Power Bonus
specials.description: +10% Power to Nature Spells (Halved if not main weapon.)

specials.name: Poison
specials.description: Inflict Poison LV 5 for 3 rounds.

description: Said to be made from the finely-honed body of a demonic insect, this spear's wrath can be felt by touch.

name: Black Spear

specials.name: Field Object Bonus
specials.description: Attacks with this weapon against field objects deal 20 more damage to them.

specials.name: Magic Armor Reduction
specials.description: Reduces effectiveness of enemy Magic Armor by 7.

specials.name: Hell Spear
specials.description: Triggers before an enemy is attacked, and replaces the attack. Causes dark spears to slice through the target and all other enemies within 5 Range, dealing Dark magic bonus damage that ignores immunities/absorbs/reflects equal to your weapon's Scaled Weapon Attack + 6.

description: Covered by darkness, this spear's magical qualities make it deadly.

name: Deadly Smile

specials.name: Fear Knockdown
specials.description: If target is Feared, they are Knocked Down.

specials.name: Jolly Slaughter
specials.description: Dance skill. Hop in place in a taunting manner while making snipping noises, removing Knockdown Immunity from all enemies (excluding bosses). Enemies within 4 Range of you may be inflicted with Fear for 3 rounds; if your Deadly Smile is Cursed or Doomed, you also perform a basic attack with it on an enemy Feared by you within 1 Range (50% damage).

description: A discarded weapon of a crazed, deformed child murderer. While not extremely deadly, it preys on the psychological weakness of its victims.

name: Lorelei

specials.name: Lorelei Dance
specials.description: On New Round: If you are within 1 Range of any Flooded Water tiles, you gain Lorelei Dance for 1 round. (On Hit: Lorelei Dance is consumed, dealing Water magic bonus damage equal to 100% of Water ATK, and restores 15 FP.)

description: A water-dancer's spear. As gracefully as they moved, the water was inspired to join.

name: Magical Moon

specials.name: Spelledge
specials.description: This weapon can be used as a casting tool for spells.

description: Suitable for dishing out punishment in the names of things. Will not help you transform, however.

name: Sea Hunter Spear

specials.name: Hunted
specials.description: Inflicts Hunted LV14 for 3 rounds if the target is a seafaring monster.

specials.name: Coral Material
specials.description: Always comes made of Coral. (+1 Power, +3 Accuracy, +3 Critical, +1 Weight, +3 Water ATK.)

description: This spear was born from the sea, and as anyone who lives there knows, anything that lives in the sea is out to get everything else... that lives in the sea.

name: Elenoa

specials.name: Dark ATK Substitution
specials.description: Replaces your Dark ATK with the target's for 2 rounds.

specials.name: Tokio
specials.description: Requires Substitute Dark ATK to be active. Consumes the status caused by the weapon and targets 1 enemy within 3 Range, drawing them in 2 tile towards you, dealing X armor-ignoring Dark damage, and inflicting Cursed Wound LV X on them for 3 rounds. (X = Twice Elenoa's total Upgrade Level (UL).)

description: A spear said to once belong to a priest who believed in dark deities.

name: Gae Bolg Replica

specials.name: Divine Weapon
specials.description: Always comes enchanted with Divine Weapon. (+2 Power, +5 Accuracy, +5 Critical, -2 Weight. Unbreakable.)

description: A replica of a set of spears said to be made from Zera's remains. It possesses extremely high power.

(This does not use up a magic stone item or require one to be equipped in your item belt.) (Aerialite (Staff): 1M. Magic stone. Forces the target to become Airborne and creates an Air Shaft at their location for 2 rounds.)

description: The head of this staff shows off a shiny, magical gem. Its magical power is obvious.

specials.description: Triggers before an enemy is attacked. Increases the damage the attack deals by 15, and if it hits, applies or powers up Cursed Wound LV X (X = 75 + 25 per Curse status effect on the target) (3 rounds) to the target.

specials.description: Also qualifies as a Axe weapon.

specials.name: Reaping Petals
specials.description: Performs a basic attack with the Roaring Rose by firing a bullet-like wrapping of petals at a target within 5 Range. (Roaring Rose has an increased distance before it is affected by Farshot Penalty, so fire away.)

specials.name: Cunning Rose
specials.description: If the Duelist skill Vent Petale is active, you gain +5 GUI.

description: 3 Momentum. This beautiful scythe reminds all those it cuts down that roses sometimes chop your head off.

name: Eternal Servitude

specials.name: Summon Wretch
specials.description: If UL is at least 10 and fighting monsters, a Swarming Wretch appears and joins your battle as an ally.

specials.name: Adon Graxis
specials.description: This skill requires a Rank D Invocation. Cannot be used before Round 2. Unleashes pure darkness on the battlefield, tainting all enemies with curses and knocking them down. (All Lv5, duration 3: Noshka's Famine, Crippling Muysig, Frailty of Credwa, Fellel's Fumble, Plisfa's Masochism)

description: Dreadful light, limited beings, let it all be drowned out... Once you submit, there's no way to break free.

name: Fellgrant Drinker

specials.name: Vampiric
specials.description: Vampiric (UL%) (Basic attacks only)

description: A vampiric spear that absorbs focus in blood to restore the health of its wielder; users say they hear screams in their head, at times, and that the spear is possessed.

name: Gryphon Wing

specials.name: Wind ATK Bonus
specials.description: Increases Wind ATK by UL/2. (Doesn't stack.)

specials.name: Gryphon Storm
specials.description: Applies or powers up Gryphon Storm LV 5 to yourself for 5 rounds. (Max LV: 5 + UL)

specials.name: Gryphon Tempest
specials.description: Whildly spin your Grypon Wing whip around you, kicking up a storm in a 3 Size Circle. Deals Wind magic damage around you, which can critically hit (can activate Gryphon Wing's On Critical effect, but only once per skill use). Creates an Air Shaft at your location for 3 rounds. If you have Grypon Storm, this skill gains additional effects based on its LV: LV5+: If you have an unsummoned Hippogriph (and can summon it), summons it to a tile near you. LV10+: +1 Circle Size. Chance to inflict Lingering Wind Damage LV X (X = Gryphon Storm LV) for 2 rounds.

description: 3 Momentum, 15 FP. With a feather-like texture, you'd think this whip would be soft, but being struck by it is anything but. In fact, the more it strikes, the wilder it gets, kicking up the winds around you.

name: Hundred-Reflection Spear

specials.name: Light Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Light bonus damage equal to UL, which ignores armor.

specials.name: Status Copy
specials.description: Copies a random, non-permanent, positive status effect the target has, except with a duration of 2 rounds. (3 Round CD)

specials.name: Mirror Knighting
specials.description: Requires a Rank D Invocation. After casting, you will temporarily change into a Mirror Knight for 5 rounds. While you are a Mirror Knight, you gain +5 to all stats, and access to certain new skills. (Far-Off Shine: 3M, 10FP. Summons the appearance of a random person as a Mirror Soldier who aids the Mirror Knight in battle.) (Vanity: 3M, 5FP. A true mirror's reflection copies every detail. Upon use, the user gains a copy of positive status(es) all enemies have, except permanent ones, including the LV, duration, etc. (Mirror Armor: Grants a percentage of automatic retaliation of magic damage, based on level (max: 20%). Physical damage will shatter then mirrors for the rest of the round, preventing the retaliation effect, but will reduce the LUC of the damager for the rest of the battle, as breaking mirrors is unlucky.)

description: A flash of brilliance in a shallow pond... A prism of pain that reflects the faces of agony that it inflicts upon your foes.

name: Overgrown Staff

specials.name: Nature Spell Power
specials.description: Increases the power of Nature spells by 1 for every plant (Flowers, Bushes, Vines) in 4 Range.

specials.name: Flower Generation
specials.description: Creates 1 flower at a random unoccupied tile in 4 Range per 6 UL. (Lasts for 3 rounds.)

description: What appears to be a druid's staff, this rod grew and fell from a great tree. Its mere presence promotes the growth of plants and empowers the natural order.

name: Staff of Eyes

specials.name: Hit Bonus
specials.description: Increases Hit by UL/2, except when Blinded.

specials.name: Analyze Weakness
specials.description: Inflicts Analyze Weakness LV UL/2 for 2 rounds.

description: This rod was most likely cultivated on a miniature planet, its seed taking root at the very center to give birth to the colossal (relatively) tree that ended up being it, after it absorbed all life around it. In our universe's standards, it's not very big, but would make a good walking stick.

name: Winged Spear

specials.name: Flight
specials.description: This unit, having wings, is capable of flight. While Airborne, this unit will hover when using Movement, allowing them to avoid field hazards and traps on the ground.

specials.name: Gain Air
specials.description: Leap into the air and hover briefly with your wings, giving you the Airborne status.

specials.name: Winged Spearstrike
specials.description: Tosses your Winged Spear in a line, reducing its durability by 2, where it will travel up to 6 Range away. If it hits an enemy, it will deal Wind magic damage to them equal to 125% of Wind ATK + UL*2.

description: 3 Momentum, 10 FP This spear has wings, no bulls required. They almost seem... alive, in a way, it's disturbing. But whatever magic holds it together will let you use those wings almost as if they were your own. That, and the spear is capable of flying quite far and returning, in a special type of attack.
